verification_commands.ac3:
set -u
F=docs/criteria/scoring_map/process.md
test -f "$F" || { echo "ac3 RED: $F missing"; exit 1; }
command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo "ac3 RED: python3 missing"; exit 1; }
python3 - <<'PYEOF' || exit 1
import re, sys
F = "docs/criteria/scoring_map/process.md"
raw = open(F, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().replace("\r", "")
def body(name):
    # NOTE: this is PYTHON regex, so the whitespace class is [ \t], not the POSIX
    # [[:space:]] the bash fences use. A POSIX class inside a Python character set is
    # a nested-set warning that silently matches the wrong characters, and that is how
    # the survey draft's scan failed to see sections that were present on the tree -
    # the groom fixes the measurer, not the measurement.
    m = re.search(r"^## %s[ \t]*$" % re.escape(name), raw, re.M)
    if not m:
        return None
    rest = raw[m.end():]
    n = re.search(r"^## ", rest, re.M)
    return rest[: n.start()] if n else rest
fail = []
for dim, must in (("Agent Team Specification", ["AGENTS.md", "SKILL.md"]),
                  ("Context Management", ["AGENTS.md", "docs/"])):
    b = body(dim)
    if b is None:
        fail.append("no '## %s' section - the rubric names this dimension verbatim" % dim)
        continue
    c = re.search(r"^- Claim:[ \t]*(\d+)/(\d+)[ \t]*$", b, re.M)
    if not c:
        fail.append("%s: no '- Claim: N/M' line" % dim)
    elif int(c.group(1)) > int(c.group(2)) or int(c.group(2)) != 2:
        fail.append("%s: claim %s/%s does not use the rubric maximum 2" % (dim, c.group(1), c.group(2)))
    if not re.search(r"^- Reason: .+", b, re.M):
        fail.append("%s: no measured Reason line" % dim)
    ep = re.findall(r"^- First entry point:[ \t]*`([^`]+)`", b, re.M)
    if len(ep) != 1:
        fail.append("%s: %d First entry point lines, want exactly 1" % (dim, len(ep)))
    else:
        import os
        p = ep[0]
        if not p.startswith("http") and not os.path.exists(p):
            fail.append("%s: first entry point '%s' does not exist on this tree" % (dim, p))
    for tok in must:
        if tok not in b:
            fail.append("%s: the record never names %s - that is the surface the rubric grades" % (dim, tok))
    for path in re.findall(r"`([A-Za-z0-9][^`\s]*/[^`\s]*)`", b):
        import os
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            fail.append("%s: evidence path '%s' does not exist" % (dim, path))
if fail:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED:\n" + "".join("  - " + f + "\n" for f in fail))
    raise SystemExit(1)
# the surfaces the record points at must really be the multi-role team the claim asserts
roles = [r for r in __import__("os").listdir("skills") if __import__("os").path.exists("skills/%s/SKILL.md" % r)]
if len(roles) < 4:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: only %d skills/<role>/SKILL.md exist (%s) - the Agent Team claim needs the real role set\n" % (len(roles), roles))
    raise SystemExit(1)
# The two claims name specific structures, so those structures are measured here rather
# than trusted from the record's prose: the process document must really document agent
# context loading, AGENTS.md must really carry the pointer section, and docs/team must
# really hold the role descriptions the Agent Team reason cites.
import io, os
proc = open("docs/process.md", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().replace("\r", "")
if "## Agent context loading" not in proc:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: docs/process.md no longer carries the '## Agent context loading' heading the Context Management claim cites - the record describes a structure that has moved\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
agents = open("AGENTS.md", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().replace("\r", "")
if "## Pointers" not in agents:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: AGENTS.md no longer carries a '## Pointers' section - the pointer-to-modular-docs clause of the Context Management claim is that section\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
team = sorted(f for f in os.listdir("docs/team") if f.endswith(".md"))
if len(team) < 3:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: docs/team holds %d role descriptions (%s) - the Agent Team reason cites the pm/software-engineer/qa-engineer trio\n" % (len(team), team))
    raise SystemExit(1)
chapters = sorted(f for f in os.listdir("docs/requirements") if f.startswith("Chapter"))
if len(chapters) < 17:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: docs/requirements holds %d chapter files - the Context Management claim calls the requirements tree modular and 17 chapters is what was measured at groom\n" % len(chapters))
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("ac3 evidence: docs/process.md carries '## Agent context loading', AGENTS.md carries '## Pointers', docs/team holds %d role descriptions, docs/requirements holds %d chapter files" % (len(team), len(chapters)))
print("ac3 GREEN: AGENT TEAM SPECIFICATION AND CONTEXT MANAGEMENT recorded - both sections carry a claim within the rubric maximum 2, one existing first entry point each, every evidence path resolves, and the named surfaces are real (%d role skill files present)" % len(roles))
PYEOF
verification_commands.ac4:

H2=$(tr -d '\r' < README.md | grep -cE "^## [^#]")
echo "ac4 evidence: README as found on this tree lines=$T h2=$H2 digest=${D:0:12}..."
[ "$H2" = "17" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: README carries $H2 level-2 headings - t112 writes zero README bytes, so if the count moved someone else's card is entangled with this one; stop and separate the deltas"; exit 1; }
if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CH=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- README.md docs/state/merge_test_index.json openapi.yaml render.yaml backend frontend e2e ops observability incident-response .github docs/plan.md docs/backlog.md docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md docs/criteria/req_coverage_verification.md docs/criteria/dashboard_verification.md docs/criteria/infra_verification.md docs/criteria/security_ops_verification.md AGENTS.md | grep -c .)
  [ "$CH" = "0" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: $CH tracked files changed under README/index/product/workflow/other-report surfaces - t112's write surface is docs/criteria/scoring_map/process.md and NOTHING else"; git diff --name-only HEAD | sed 's/^/    /'; exit 1; }
  UT=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vE '^docs/criteria/scoring_map/(process|app|delivery|telemetry)[.]md$|^docs/issues/(groom/)?t112[.]md$|^docs/state/outputs/t112_.*[.]json$|^scratch/|^build/|^docs/state/history/|node_modules' | grep -c .)
  [ "$UT" = "0" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: untracked files appeared outside the owned surface:"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vE '^docs/criteria/scoring_map/(process|app|delivery|telemetry)[.]md$|^docs/issues/(groom/)?t112[.]md$|^docs/state/outputs/t112_.*[.]json$|^scratch/|^build/|^docs/state/history/|node_modules' | sed 's/^/    /'; exit 1; }
  echo "ac4 evidence: zero changed tracked files and zero untracked files outside the owned surface"
fi
# the record must not be a copy of the README or of a sibling cluster file
if [ -f docs/criteria/scoring_map/app.md ]; then
  cmp -s "$F" docs/criteria/scoring_map/app.md && { echo "ac4 RED: process.md is byte-identical to app.md - a duplicated record is not a verification record"; exit 1; }
fi
grep -qiE "TODO|TBD|placeholder|not yet|lands with" "$F" && { echo "ac4 RED: the record carries a placeholder token - a scoring map with a TODO is a lie with extra steps"; exit 1; }
echo "ac4 GREEN: ZERO-BYTE PURITY - process.md is the only write surface; README (17 H2, $T lines), the merge index, the product tree, the workflows directory and the other five criteria reports carry zero bytes from t112, and the record contains no placeholder token"
